name: Mad Chihuahua🐕
desc:
🐕 Welcome to Mad Chihuahua! 🐕

⭐ HOW TO PLAY

Buy Chihuahuas 🐕
Chihuahuas drop Bones over time 🦴
Deposit Bones to earn Cash 💰
Use Cash to buy more Chihuahuas 💵
Merge Chihuahuas to unlock higher-tier Chihuahuas 🔧
Chihuahuas sniff out Lucky Boxes over time 🎁
Open Lucky Boxes to get extra Chihuahuas 🐕
Unlock all 18 Chihuahuas and complete your Index! ⭐

🐾 YOUR PACK

Your Chihuahuas follow you around as pets 🐾
Make them do tricks: Sit, Belly Up, Bang! and more 🐶
Snap photos with your pack 📸

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
